description: This file defines the AttendanceService class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing employee attendance records, including CRUD operations, configuration management, and permission checks related to attendance workflows.
external_files: OrangeHRM v a a Core	raits	raits	raits.Auth	raits.AuthUserTrait
OrangeHRM v a a Core	raits	raits	raits	raits.UserRoleManagerTrait

classes.name: AttendanceService
classes.description: Service class managing employee attendance operations, permissions, and workflow configurations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the AccessFlowStateMachineService instance used for managing workflow state machine records.

methods.name: getAttendanceDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the AttendanceDao for persistence operations related to attendance records.

methods.name: setAttendanceDao
methods.description: Sets the AttendanceDao instance.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to modify current time.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Saves an attendance punch record.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-out records for an employee.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records for an employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for an employee on a specific date.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes an attendance record by its ID.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attendance record by ID.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone string for a given offset value.

methods.name: getTimezoneArray
methods.description: Provides the complete list of timezone offsets and labels.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Returns timezone label based on client’s offset.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records during editing.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-out records during editing.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in/out records during editing.

methods.name: searchAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Searches attendance records based on multiple optional criteria.

methods.name: getLatestPunchInRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the latest punch-in record for an employee.

methods.name: getPunchTimeUserConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if user has configuration to modify punch time.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsBetweenTwoDays
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for an employee between two dates.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for multiple employees within date range.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if user can change current time configuration.

methods.name: enableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Enables permission for user to change current time.

methods.name: disableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Disables permission for user to change current time.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Allows user to modify attendance configuration.

methods.name: disableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Revokes user's permission to modify attendance configuration.

methods.name: canSupervisorModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if supervisor has modification permissions.

methods.name: enableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Enables supervisor permissions for attendance modifications.

methods.name: disableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Disables supervisor modification capabilities.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheEditActions
methods.description: Checks if the logged-in user is authorized to edit the given attendance record based on workflow rules.
